summary: Fractal web renders resolved folder-only sidebar nesting through the shared sidebar projection and React Aria tree, retaining the flat roster for legacy unresolved arrangements.

replay.detail: Read-only web adapter; no runtime replay change.

schema.detail: Uses existing native arrangement schemas and authoritative resolution.

compatibility.detail: Unresolved arrangements retain the existing flat agent roster. Dormant placements do not become visible agent seats.

manual.detail: No host rollout or installation change.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
